title: SpireBench：用《杀戮尖塔》评估智能体模型的长时程策略能力
summary: SpireBench 让 20 个大语言模型在最高难度下完整游玩商业卡牌游戏《杀戮尖塔》，评估其长时程策略推理。前沿模型能击败启发式基线并接近普通玩家，但远逊于专家，且随游戏进程差距扩大；模型普遍误判风险、过度保守，无法从跨局记忆中学习。该基准首次提供完整原版游戏环境，可定位智能体失败原因。
summary_en: SpireBench evaluates 20 LLMs playing the full commercial deck-builder Slay the Spire at max difficulty. Frontier models beat heuristic baselines and match average humans but lag experts, with the gap widening over longer runs. Models misjudge risk, play overly cautiously, and fail to learn from cross-run memories. It is the first harness to provide the complete original game, offering an unsaturated long-horizon benchmark that locates where and why agents fail.
